# Survivalist Boards

> > A community-driven forum dedicated to survivalism, gear discussions, and everyday carry equipment for preparedness enthusiasts.

Survivalist Boards is an active community forum where members share knowledge about survival gear, daily carry (EDC) equipment, firearms, and preparedness strategies. The site serves as a gathering place for survivalists to discuss tactics, equipment reviews, and real-world applications of survival skills.

## Key Topics

- daily-carry
- EDC (Everyday Carry)
- firearms
- survivalism
- gear
- weapons
- community discussion
- preparedness
- Survivalist Forum
- equipment reviews

## Community Discussions

- [What did you carry today?](https://www.survivalistboards.com/threads/what-did-you-carry-today.1015414): Community discussion thread about daily carry gear and EDC equipment where members share their everyday carry setups and gear choices
